sentences.text: In short: HUSNES FRISØR AS is an established company in "skjønnhetspleie" based in Kvinnherad, loss-making in 2025.
HUSNES FRISØR AS is registered in the industry "Skjønnhetspleie"; its registered activity is "Salg av hårpleieprodukter".
HUSNES FRISØR AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1998-12-15, registered in Kvinnherad.
It had 2 full-time equivalents (2025 annual accounts), reported revenue of NOK 1.79M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 34,307 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -1.9% and a moderate equity ratio of 24% of total assets.

Revenue fell 3.0% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.84M to NOK 1.79M); it was NOK 1.95M in 2023. The annual result was a loss in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: -NOK 125,235, 2024: -NOK 23,272, 2025: -NOK 34,850).
HUSNES FRISØR AS is led by CEO Hilde Norunn Nordnes and board chair Kjersti Kaldestad.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2019-09-18.
HUSNES FRISØR AS has 1 registered workplace.
